scope: Provider-free join of 539 DEV020 comparable opening/observed-peak records with compact DEV014 peak-to-subsequent-trough/later-observation facts.

coverage.note: DEV014 retained lifecycle windows are bounded observed windows, not complete history or verified ATH paths.

interpretation: Within this retained, post-peak-trough-qualified subset, crossing back through opening is associated with extremely low retained later valuations. The selection is conditioned on a retained peak-to-subsequent-trough fact, so it cannot estimate a population-wide first-crossing probability or prove that opening crossing causes collapse.

candidate_exits.reason: Compact records retain extrema and later/latest observations, not threshold-crossing time, tradable fill, subsequent recovery path, or exit execution.

peak_multiple_groups: Not calculated as a risk rule: the available overlap is overwhelmingly selected terminal/trough evidence and would misleadingly imply every peak-multiple group has an identical collapse rate. A complete unselected post-peak panel is required.
representatives: Individual examples omitted from the compact artifact because no unselected ordered recovery path is retained; selecting extrema would imply an executable narrative not supported by the data.
storage: Compact JSON only; no raw payload, acquisition, evidence mutation, or 500 MB growth path.
